Hi Claire —

Thanks — excited to run this with you. High-level MAP and next steps below (I attached a short prompt-pack guidance doc that outlines required labeling and allowed metadata).

1) Week 0 (this week) — Paperwork
   - Exchange NDA & procurement info (Acme to sign standard Redwood POC NDA)
   - Redwood shares prompt-pack guidance and usage policy (attached)
2) Week 1 — Data exchange & onboarding
   - Acme uploads anonymized testcases (S3 link or secure Drive) + corpus README
   - Redwood validates format and runs quick ingest test (3 business days)
3) Week 2 — Evaluation run
   - Redwood runs two evaluation passes: reranking test suite and response-clamp tests
   - Deliverable: scored report + per-testcase logs, top failure modes
4) Week 3 — Review & close
   - Joint review call; decide on follow-ups or expansion
   - Data deletion or return per agreed retention policy (default: remove all PII & delete copies within 30 days of close)

Usage constraints we propose (short version):
- PII: Redwood will not retain personal data beyond ingest validation; any PII discovered will be redacted at ingest and flagged to Acme
- Derivative models: Acme grants Redwood the right to run the eval and produce aggregate metrics only; no model training on original testcases without a separate license
- Redistribution: No redistribution of raw testcases outside Redwood evaluation team; aggregated failure examples allowed with redaction

Attached: redwood_promptpack_guidelines.pdf — includes filename conventions, required README fields, and a sample manifest.

If that looks OK I will open a secure upload for your team and loop in Marissa from Commercial to confirm billing / credit terms for the POC.
